eco.title: Capture a task in seconds, wherever you are
eco.subtitle: MILA's edge is practicality: ideas don't wait for you to open a system. Web, computer and phone — always one tap away.
eco.bothNote: Works the same for companies (corporate plans) and personal use (family plans).
eco.voiceDesc: Hold the mic, speak for up to 10 seconds and release: the transcript becomes a task due tomorrow. Review or discard before it's created.
eco.desktopDesc: A handy gadget, discreet on the edge of your screen: pending tasks always in sight, quick capture, and a pulse of light when something new lands on you.
eco.mobileDesc: Your tasks in your pocket: pending list, status changes and voice — same account everywhere.

how.title: From conversation to done, in 4 steps

steps.d: Note the task right away — by text, in seconds. Standalone or inside an event.
Set the owner, due date and priority. For you or for someone on the team.
See the status of everything in dashboards by person, team, area and organization.
Record what was done. History is saved and becomes a productivity metric.

contexts.title: One account. Two worlds, never mixed.
contexts.subtitle: See your work tasks within the organization and your personal family tasks — in the same login, one click to switch between them.
contexts.corpDesc: Structure the company as it really is — Organization, Areas and Teams — and give each manager visibility into what's happening. Delegate with clarity and track results, not promises.
corpBullets: Structure by organization, area and team
Delegation with owner, due date and priority
contexts.corpResult: Result: less rework, deadlines met and a team that knows exactly what to do.
contexts.familyDesc: No bureaucracy: add your family members and organize what needs to get done. Everyone knows their part, and what was agreed stops turning into an argument.
familyBullets: Simple people registration — no corporate structure
Personal and household tasks in one place
Who does what, with due date and reminder
Plans for 5 or 10 people, at an affordable price
contexts.familyResult: Result: nothing forgotten, no one overloaded and more peace of mind day to day.
